maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly SaaS EHR subscriptions and RCM billing services for practices, not repair or aftermarket servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private medical practices paying software and billing fees; ultimate payers are mostly practices and commercial insurers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly from selling EHR, RCM and AI products, though it made acquisitions like Medsphere; not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: EHR, practice management and billing systems run daily clinical and revenue operations; switching means migration, retraining and billing disruption.

notes: CareCloud has made several acquisitions over time, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call.
